name: hebrew_pipeline

transitions.operation: normalise surface layout to logical order (undo direction/boustrophedon)
per-letter lookup in the encoding bundle
concatenate generator images (a word grows by one letter per position)
evaluate writhe and linking of the closure

notes: text (flat) -> frame (positive) -> encoding (bundle, positive) -> words (negative) -> invariants (flat). Every curvature change is declared at its interface.
